messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 ALERT — OpalEdge (dedicated VPC ded-opaledge-3) reporting elevated error rate and token timeouts to the Redwood API since 2024-06-07T04:13:09Z. Impact: customer requests returning 5xx / truncated responses. Pager set to oncall SRE. https://internal.incident/1729456789 :rotating_light:
mira: I'm on it. seeing spike in error-rate and tail latency around 04:12-04:15 UTC. Error signature shows repeated "kv cache miss" followed by retries, then final 5xx. Affected route: /v1/generate (model default for tenant). Initial customer report says ~30% requests failing.
jon: digging into runtime logs now. attaching quick snippet from host gpu-12: ```
2024-06-07T04:13:40Z ERROR model-serving: request_id=abc123 tenant=opaledge pool=ded-opaledge-3 model=gptx-v2 msg="kv cache miss -> stall" mem_free=2.3GB active_kv_pages=512
2024-06-07T04:13:42Z WARN  runtime: fallback_attempt model=gptx-v2-safe route=auto
2024-06-07T04:14:01Z ERROR http: upstream write failed: write timeout
```
kai: hypothesis: recent runtime kernel selection for long-context paths is thrashing KV cache on this tenant's workload. The safe variant we keep for OpalEdge is `gptx-v2-safe` (lower memory, deterministic routing, slightly higher latency but stable). Suggest we apply a tenant-level override to route OpalEdge to safe variant while we investigate.
leah: ops contract check — OpalEdge has enterprise SLA and allows emergency routing overrides without signed approval for P1s. I'll send them a heads-up but we can proceed.
mira: plan: 1) canary-pin 5% of traffic to gptx-v2-safe on ded-opaledge-3 2) smoke test 3) if green, escalate to 100% override for tenant 4) create follow-up RCA ticket and rollback plan. Approving canary now.
jon: running canary pin command (internal tooling):
```
# pin 5% of tenant traffic to safe variant
rdwctl tenant override --tenant opaledge --pool ded-opaledge-3 --model gptx-v2-safe --percent 5 --reason "mitigation: runtime kv thrash" --issued_by mira
```
Executed at 2024-06-07T04:18:02Z. Monitoring.
incident-bot: Canary metrics update: 04:19 UTC — 5% traffic to gptx-v2-safe; error-rate on the canary slice: 0.8% (baseline), latency stable. Non-canary slice still showing ~28% errors.
mira: canary looks good. escalating to full tenant override. Applying full pin now.
jon: full override command:
```
rdwctl tenant override --tenant opaledge --pool ded-opaledge-3 --model gptx-v2-safe --percent 100 --reason "P1 mitigation: maintain availability"
```
Executed 04:22 UTC. Immediate drop in global error rate for tenant to ~1.1%. :white_check_mark:
kai: notes: this is a mitigation — we need to investigate the kernel selection change in runtime v2.14 that got promoted yesterday. Opening tracking issue: https://internal.issues/RT-3345 (assigning eng-runtime). Suggest follow-up actions: revert runtime kernel change for affected pool or tune KV cache thresholds for opaledge.
leah: I'll notify OpalEdge: "We've routed your traffic to a stable model variant to restore availability; we're investigating root cause and will share timeline." Will post customer ack here when they respond.
mira: handing off active paging to jon for overnight follow-up and RCA tracking. Key notes for handoff: - mitigation applied (gptx-v2-safe pinned 100%) - canary passed - trending: memory pressure at 04:12-04:15 - likely kernel selection regression in v2.14 - runbook link: https://wiki/runbooks/tenant-override - follow-up owner: eng-runtime (RT-3345).
jon: taking over. I'll monitor 1h then set quiet-hours alert if stable. plan immediate next steps: collect perf dumps from gpu-12, compare kernel decisions between v2.13 and v2.14, and schedule rollback window if we see reproduction.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident status changed: MITIGATED -> customer traffic routed to safe variant. Severity downgraded to P2 for follow-up.
mira: leaving these handoff notes in the incident doc and creating an action item list: ["collect perf dumps", "compare kernel selectors", "evaluate cache thresholds", "test rollback on staging"]. Assigning to jon + kai.
leah: OpalEdge reply: "Thanks — confirmed traffic restored and responses look normal on our side. Please keep us posted on RCA." forwarding email thread to account team. :thumbsup:
jon: quick smoke curl to confirm (useful for runbook):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"tenant":"opaledge","model":"gptx-v2-safe","input":"status check"}' | jq '.status'
```
Response: "ok" on 04:25 UTC.
mira: closing active page. leaving the incident open for RCA tracking. If eng-runtime needs emergency rollback, re-pager oncall. Great work team. :pray:
kai: one more note — enable temporary increased telemetry retention for ded-opaledge-3 for 72 hours so eng-runtime has full traces. I'll file request.
jon: filing RCA ticket now and linking to the mitigation commands + perf dumps. ETA for full RCA: 72 hours.
incident-bot: Incident 1729456789 — MITIGATED at 2024-06-07T04:25:10Z. Follow-ups: RT-3345 (eng-runtime), ACTION-1729456790 (telemetry retention), TICKET-1729456800 (customer comms).
